scope: Main delegation task-scope admission and resolver contract
changes: createSessionsApi reuses SessionDelegationDependencies.resolveTaskScope for its injected resolver.
Task scope selects the explicit session/task/generation link among all links.
Missing tasks and missing, foreign-session or old-generation links reject before Gateway delegation.
previousFailures: Two focused negative controls failed before the source repair; five selected controls already passed.
Before-node-types also reported a missing generated extension bridge alongside the resolver signature error.
Earlier candidate checks failed when shared dependency entry points disappeared; dedicated offline installs restored the locked dependencies.
The first offline install used the wrong store root; the first contract invocation used a nonexistent script. Original logs remain indexed.
remainingParentAcceptance: Discussion-to-execution automatic task creation and the ten-turn discussion journey.
Fork/handoff task linkage and write-claim generation journeys through production owners.
